name: rosetta-leap-year
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

is_leap_year(year: int) -> bool =>
    year % 4 == 0 /\ (year % 100 != 0 \/ year % 400 == 0)

for year in [1900, 1994, 1996, 2000, 2024, 2100] do
    let kind = if is_leap_year(year) then "leap" else "common" fi

    write_line("{year} is a {kind} year")
od
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

is_leap_year(year: int) -> bool =>
    year % 4 == 0 /\ (year % 100 != 0 \/ year % 400 == 0)

for year in [1900, 1994, 1996, 2000, 2024, 2100] do
    let kind = if is_leap_year(year) then "leap" else "common" fi

    write_line("{year} is a {kind} year")
od
output:
1900 is a common year
1994 is a common year
1996 is a leap year
2000 is a leap year
2024 is a leap year
2100 is a common year
